The "Aerobic composting pretreatment" does not refer to new equipment or devices but rather employs traditional composting methods to treat the materials. In this study, the composting setup used was a thick-walled foam box with inner dimensions of 55 cm (length) × 50 cm (width) × 80 cm (height). A perforated plate and an aeration pipe were installed at the bottom of the box (as shown in the figure below). During the composting process, an aerator was used to intermittently force aeration through the aeration pipe, with an aeration frequency of 5 minutes per hour and an aeration rate of 600–800 ml per minute.

Production cost (CNY/g) = Electricity consumption × Electricity price ÷ Total SCFAs production. For conventional low-temperature thermal pretreatment, energy consumption was mainly from oven heating; for aerobic composting pretreatment, energy consumption was primarily from aeration.
